enriched_activities.activity: Working a night shift as an aged-care support worker at a residential aged care facility, doing resident checks, personal care rounds and handover notes
enriched_activities.desc: Receive handover from previous shift. Walk to resident rooms. Knock on door. Enter room. Check on resident. Assist resident with toileting. Change bed linens. Record notes in log. Walk to next room. Repeat checks. Assist with personal care. Prepare and serve drinks. Monitor residents. Write handover notes. Report to supervisor.

enriched_activities.activity: Commuting home from the night shift by train and bus, listening to quiet audio and keeping to the planned route
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to train station. Wait on platform. Board train. Sit down. Put on headphones. Listen to audio. Get off at bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Sit down. Get off at home stop. Walk home.

enriched_activities.activity: Making a pot of tea and a small flexitarian breakfast, keeping noise minimal and putting dishes straight into the dishwasher
enriched_activities.desc: Enter kitchen. Fill kettle with water. Turn on kettle. Open cupboard. Take out teabag. Place teabag in mug. Pour hot water into mug. Open fridge. Take out bread and spread. Prepare toast. Eat breakfast. Drink tea. Put dishes in dishwasher. Wipe bench.

enriched_activities.activity: Showering and completing a short written wind-down routine before daytime sleep
enriched_activities.desc: Enter bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on shower. Adjust water temperature. Step into shower. Wash body. Shampoo hair. Rinse hair. Turn off shower. Step out. Pick up towel. Dry body. Dry hair. Put on clothes. Write in journal. Turn off light. Leave bathroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Sleeping after the night shift with the fan on and the phone set to silent, with a written do-not-disturb note on the door
enriched_activities.desc: Enter bedroom. Close door. Write do-not-disturb note. Place note on door. Turn on fan. Adjust fan speed. Pick up phone. Set phone to silent. Place phone on nightstand. Lie down on bed. Pull blanket over body. Close eyes. Sleep. Turn to left side. Adjust pillow. Sleep. Turn to right side. Sleep.

enriched_activities.activity: Eating a late lunch of rice and vegetables cooked in the rice cooker, drinking tea and reviewing the weekly budget in cash
enriched_activities.desc: Enter kitchen. Open fridge. Take out container of rice and vegetables. Open container. Scoop rice and vegetables onto plate. Place plate in microwave. Close microwave door. Set timer. Press start. Wait for microwave. Take out plate. Sit at table. Pick up spoon. Eat rice and vegetables. Drink tea. Open wallet. Take out cash. Count cash. Open budget notebook. Write down expenses.

enriched_activities.activity: Resting quietly, reading incoming text messages and checking the unit timetable and reminders on the phone
enriched_activities.desc: Lie down on bed. Pick up phone. Unlock phone. Open messaging app. Read text messages. Type reply. Send reply. Open calendar app. Check timetable. Check reminders. Set alarm for next shift. Place phone on nightstand.

enriched_activities.activity: Commuting by train and bus from Clayton to the Monash University campus for coursework
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to train station. Wait on platform. Board train. Sit down. Read placement notes. Get off at bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Sit down. Continue reading notes. Get off at campus. Walk to classroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Attending Master of Social Work coursework seminars and a group project meeting on campus, taking detailed written notes
enriched_activities.desc: Enter classroom. Sit at desk. Take out notebook. Pick up pen. Listen to lecturer. Write notes. Raise hand. Ask question. Participate in group discussion. Write group project notes. Share ideas. Take down action items. Pack up materials. Leave classroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Commuting home from campus by bus and train while reading over placement notes
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Sit down. Take out placement notes. Read notes. Get off at train station. Wait for train. Board train. Sit down. Continue reading notes. Get off at home station. Walk home.

enriched_activities.activity: Batch-cooking a flexitarian dinner of lentils, vegetables and rice, and packing a portion for the next shift
enriched_activities.desc: Enter kitchen. Wash hands. Open fridge. Take out ingredients. Chop vegetables. Cook lentils and rice. Pack portion. Store in fridge.

enriched_activities.activity: Eating dinner with a cup of tea and wiping down the shared bench and stovetop
enriched_activities.desc: Sit at table. Pick up spoon. Eat dinner. Drink tea. Stand up. Take plate to sink. Scrape leftovers. Pick up cloth. Wipe bench. Wipe stovetop. Rinse cloth. Hang cloth.

enriched_activities.activity: Washing up and drying the dishes, then clearing and labelling the food containers in the refrigerator
enriched_activities.desc: Fill sink with water. Add dish soap. Pick up sponge. Wash dishes. Rinse dishes. Dry with towel. Put dishes in cupboard. Open fridge. Take out food containers. Label containers with marker. Place containers back in fridge. Close fridge.

enriched_activities.activity: Writing next week's reminders and shift roster into the paper planner and checking the weekly budget against receipts
enriched_activities.desc: Sit at desk. Turn on desk lamp. Open paper planner. Pick up pen. Write next week's reminders. Write shift roster. Open budget notebook. Take out receipts. Compare receipts with budget. Mark off expenses. Close notebook. Close planner.

enriched_activities.activity: Studying course readings and drafting an assignment on the computer at the desk with the desk lamp on
enriched_activities.desc: Sit at desk. Turn on desk lamp. Open computer. Open course reading. Read. Highlight text. Open word processor. Type assignment draft. Save document.

enriched_activities.activity: Running a load of laundry in the washing machine and tidying personal items in the bathroom
enriched_activities.desc: Enter bathroom. Open washing machine. Load clothes. Add detergent. Close washing machine. Set cycle. Press start. Pick up personal items. Organize items on shelf. Wipe sink. Turn off light. Leave bathroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Sending text messages to family in China and looking at the photo of the family dog
enriched_activities.desc: Pick up phone. Open messaging app. Select contact. Type message. Send message. Wait for reply. Receive reply. Read reply. Type response. Send response. Open photo app. View photo of dog. Zoom in. Close app. Place phone down.

enriched_activities.activity: Drinking a cup of tea and doing a calm breathing exercise to settle anxiety before bed
enriched_activities.desc: Sit on bed. Pick up teacup. Sip tea. Put down cup. Close eyes. Inhale deeply. Exhale slowly. Repeat breathing. Pick up cup. Sip tea. Put down cup. Continue breathing. Open eyes. Pick up cup. Finish tea. Place cup on nightstand.

enriched_activities.activity: Brushing teeth and completing the evening personal care routine
enriched_activities.desc: Enter bathroom. Turn on light. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Spit. Wipe mouth. Wash face. Turn off light. Leave bathroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Sleeping in Bedroom 1 with the fan on low and the phone charging on silent
enriched_activities.desc: Lie down on bed. Turn on fan to low. Plug in phone. Set phone to silent. Pull blanket up. Adjust pillow. Close eyes. Sleep.
